author: Sabita Singh Meera
scope: Two comparison submissions; review candidates only. No publication authorization.
lyrics:
[Spoken word]
गांव का सुनसान प्लेटफार्म,
बरसती बूँदों की छांव,
पटरी पर धीमे-धीमे
गुजरती ट्रेन की थरथर ध्वनि।
आज फिर वही जगह
जहाँ तुम छोड़ गए थे,
और अब भी प्रतीक्षा में हूँ,
कि लौट आओगे कभी...।
[End]
text_note: Exact eight verse lines; bracketed performance cues added, printed end marker and location omitted from speech.
cultural_direction: Contemporary intimate Hindi literary reading. No claim to represent all Hindi recitation traditions. Listener checks native diction, word fidelity, phrasing and emotional fit.

variants.title: KBL · क्षणिका · A Bare voice
variants.style: Solo female Hindi spoken-word poetry recital. Warm, intimate, close dry microphone; natural Hindi diction and conversational literary phrasing. A deserted village railway platform, rain, remembered separation, unresolved hope. Gentle breath and meaningful pauses; let धीमे-धीमे गुजरती ट्रेन flow as one phrase, soften आज फिर, leave the final hope unresolved. Speak the supplied poem once, exactly in order. Unaccompanied bare speaking voice, quiet room, free speech rhythm. No singing, melody, chanting, rap, chorus, repeated lines, added words, instruments, music, sound effects, applause or dramatic reverb. Short complete recital, silence at the end.
variants.exclude: singing, melodic vocals, chant, rap, chorus, backing vocals, instrumental music, drums, sound effects, autotune
